name: CELL_THERAPY_REQ_VERIFY
description: This table stores the users and roles that are required to verify the cell therapy infusion plan.

columns.name: TREATMENT_PLAN_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the plan record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: ANY_MEMBER_YN
columns.description: This item stores if any team member can verify the cell therapy infusion plan to complete the required verification.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This item stores the user that is required to verify the cell therapy infusion plan.

columns.name: USER_ID_NAME
columns.description: The name of the user record. This name may be hidden.

columns.name: TREATMENT_TEAM_ROLE_C_NAME
columns.description: This item stores the role that is required to verify the cell therapy infusion plan.
